README.md.purpose: Public repo overview: what this is, how to use the site/skills/prompts exports.

.yamllint.yml.purpose: Was: disables yamllint's truthy/line-length rules for Super-Linter's yamllint. REMOVED at turncount 2 along with Super-Linter (user instruction) -- had no other consumer.

.stylelintrc.json.purpose: Was: extends stylelint-config-standard, disabling 4 cosmetic rules for Super-Linter's stylelint. REMOVED at turncount 2 along with Super-Linter (user instruction) -- had no other consumer.

docs/.purpose: GitHub Pages site source (the Pages 'source' folder). Plain HTML/CSS, no build step, no JS.

index.html.purpose: Home page: card grid linking every principle page, in pedagogical order. Its outer <div class="wrap"> got a wrap-wide modifier class at turncount 10 so its card grid can use a wider shell than the site's default reading-column width.

about.html.purpose: How to read the site and use the /skills and /prompts exports.

404.html.purpose: Custom GitHub Pages error page (added turncount 12), placed at the Pages root per GitHub's exact requirement. Follows the site's own Empty & Error States principle (what happened / what to do next). Deliberately excluded from sitemap.xml.

sitemap.xml.purpose: sitemaps.org-protocol XML sitemap covering all 19 real pages (added turncount 12). datePublished-equivalent lastmod values pulled from real git history, not fabricated.

robots.txt.purpose: Allow-all robots.txt referencing sitemap.xml's full absolute URL (added turncount 12).

assets/style.css.purpose: Whole site's CSS: design tokens, responsive nav, good/bad example blocks, checklist styling, light/dark mode, print stylesheet, logical (RTL-safe) properties. Turncount 10: unified header/main/footer to one shared --content-width (was misaligned at 60rem vs 42rem), added a decoupled --prose-width for flowing text, a --content-width-wide/.wrap-wide shell for the home page's card grid, real depth (shadow tokens, hover lift) on cards, and custom-drawn checklist checkboxes + a details/summary chevron replacing bare default widgets. Turncount 14: added the Craft component block -- course-meta/course-progress badge, lesson-progress-list + lesson-check states, lesson-nav, and the full quiz component (options, hover/disabled/correct/incorrect states, feedback panel) plus matching print rules. The course-progress badge's display rule is deliberately split into `.course-progress:not([hidden]) { display: inline-block; }` plus a separate unscoped properties block -- a plain `.course-progress { display: inline-block; ... }` has the same specificity as the UA stylesheet's `[hidden] { display: none }` and silently wins the tie, defeating the hidden attribute (caught via a real Playwright test, not by reading the CSS).

assets/print-details.js.purpose: Forces every page's collapsed 'Go deeper' <details> open for the duration of printing (beforeprint/afterprint listeners), then reverts. Added turncount 9 because this Chromium build does not auto-expand <details> for print -- verified via an actual rendered PDF, not assumed.

assets/craft-progress.js.purpose: Shared vanilla-JS helper for the Craft course system (added turncount 14). Reads/writes localStorage key craft-progress as {courseId: {lessonId: true}}. Wires up quiz click handling (disable all options, mark correct/incorrect, reveal feedback, record completion on any answer), renders per-lesson progress checks on course-overview pages, and renders/unhides the course-level completion badge. No accounts, no server -- client-side only by design.

.nojekyll.purpose: Skips GitHub's default Jekyll processing since the site is plain static HTML.

principles/*.html (17 files).purpose: One canonical page per concept, each following CLAUDE.md's 6-part skeleton (definition, why it matters, core rule, good/bad example, common mistakes, checklist). Turncount 12: every page's <head> gained a <link rel="canonical">, Open Graph + Twitter Card meta tags, and a JSON-LD TechArticle <script> block (headline/description/datePublished/author/publisher/mainEntityOfPage) -- no og:image, deliberately, since there's no image-generation pipeline. Turncount 14: visual-hierarchy.html, color-contrast.html, and accessibility.html each gained one 'Practice this' callout link to their paired Craft course, placed immediately before the Go-deeper <details> block. Turncount 15: typography.html, spacing-layout.html, responsive-design.html, forms-inputs.html, and dark-patterns-ethics.html each gained the same cross-link to their new v6 course.

craft/.purpose: Added turncount 14. Fourth exported form (site/skills/prompts/Craft, per CLAUDE.md): short, hands-on practice courses that pair with a principle page. Static/localStorage-only 'backend' -- one manifest as the single source of truth, one folder per course, no server, no accounts, matching the site's existing no-build-step architecture. Turncount 15 (v6): 5 more courses added the same way, built by parallel subagents (one per course, writing only into its own new directory) with all shared-file integration (manifest, catalog, cross-links) done centrally afterward to avoid a 5-way write race.

courses.json.purpose: Manifest: single source of truth for the catalog page (id, title, hook, linked principle, lesson list). 8 entries as of turncount 15. Adding a course means editing this file first, per CLAUDE.md's 'Adding a new course' section.

index.html.purpose: Dedicated course index/catalog, card-grid pattern matching the home page, each card with a hidden-until-earned course-progress badge. 8 cards as of turncount 15.

visual-hierarchy/ (index.html, lesson-1..purpose: Course 'Where the Eye Goes First,' pairs with principles/visual-hierarchy.html. Quizzes: competing button weight, decorative-vs-content sizing, visual order vs. DOM/reading order.

color-contrast/ (index.html, lesson-1.ht.purpose: Course 'Contrast You Can Prove,' pairs with principles/color-contrast.html. Quizzes grounded in that page's real published contrast numbers (4.5:1 body-text minimum, 3:1 large-text minimum, its 7.7:1/2.4:1 examples), plus a color-only-meaning-fails-colorblind-users question.

accessibility/ (index.html, lesson-1.htm.purpose: Course 'Built for Everyone,' pairs with principles/accessibility.html. Quizzes: div-with-onclick isn't keyboard focusable, placeholder text isn't a real label, outline:none removes focus visibility.

typography/ (index.html, lesson-1.html,.purpose: Added turncount 15. Course 'Text People Actually Read,' pairs with principles/typography.html. Quizzes: capping line length past ~75 characters, line-height under 1.4 on body text, hierarchy needing more than one signal (size + weight).

spacing-layout/ (index.html, lesson-1.ht.purpose: Added turncount 15. Course 'Show What Belongs Together,' pairs with principles/spacing-layout.html. Quizzes: label-to-input gap smaller than group-to-group gap (proximity), picking spacing from a fixed scale instead of by eye, left alignment giving one scannable edge instead of centering.

responsive-design/ (index.html, lesson-1.purpose: Added turncount 15. Course 'One Layout, Every Screen,' pairs with principles/responsive-design.html. Quizzes: breakpoints chosen by content vs. guessed device widths, 44x44px minimum touch targets, reprioritizing mobile content instead of hiding it.

forms-inputs/ (index.html, lesson-1.html.purpose: Added turncount 15. Course 'Forms People Actually Finish,' pairs with principles/forms-inputs.html. Quizzes: placeholder text vanishing as a label, vague vs. specific error messages, validating per-field instead of only on submit.

dark-patterns-ethics/ (index.html, lesso.purpose: Added turncount 15. Course 'Design That Doesn't Trick People,' pairs with principles/dark-patterns-ethics.html. Quizzes: pre-checked opt-ins, confirmshaming vs. neutral decline wording, the roach-motel easy-in-hard-out pattern.

skills/.purpose: Claude Code skills (SKILL.md format) turning principle checklists into agent-runnable procedures.

design-critique/SKILL.md.purpose: Reviews UI/HTML against all 17 principles' checklists; links back to every canonical page.

accessibility-audit/SKILL.md.purpose: Line-by-line code-scanning a11y audit with severity tiers; links back to the accessibility page.

plain-language-rewrite/SKILL.md.purpose: Operationalizes Rule Zero itself for arbitrary text; no single canonical page (it's the site's whole ethos, not one principle).

dark-pattern-audit/SKILL.md.purpose: Flow-by-flow dark-pattern audit (pre-checked opt-ins, confirmshaming, roach motel, fabricated urgency, drip pricing, forced continuity, misdirection); links back to the dark-patterns-ethics page.

empty-error-state-review/SKILL.md.purpose: Per-state review of empty/error screens against the three-part rule (what happened, why, what's next); links back to the empty-error-states page.

performance-audit/SKILL.md.purpose: Line-by-line scan for layout-level performance causes (unsized images, render-blocking fonts, eager-loaded/oversized media, above-the-fold contention); links back to the performance page. Added turncount 12.

responsive-design-audit/SKILL.md.purpose: Line-by-line scan for fixed-width layouts, guessed device breakpoints, and touch-target sizing; links back to the responsive-design page. Added turncount 12.

prompts/.purpose: Standalone system prompts (personas + judgment), for use outside Claude Code with any LLM.

performance-reviewer.md.purpose: Performance-review persona mirroring skills/performance-audit's checklist. Added turncount 12.

responsive-design-consultant.md.purpose: Responsive-layout consulting persona mirroring skills/responsive-design-audit's checklist. Added turncount 12.

scripts/verify-site.py.purpose: Stdlib-only checker: HTML tag balance, internal link resolution, CLAUDE.md skeleton-section presence, CSS brace balance. The repo's substitute for a test suite; also run in CI.

scripts/requirements.txt.purpose: Pins html5validator==0.4.2 (the only external Python dependency, used in CI for real W3C HTML validation). Exists specifically so actions/setup-python's pip cache has a lockfile to key off.

.github/workflows/pages.yml.purpose: Builds docs/ and deploys to GitHub Pages on every push to main touching docs/**. Independent of ci.yml so a flaky external link can never block a deploy. The deploy job intentionally has no `environment: github-pages` block (removed at turncount 3): that environment's branch-restriction rule only allows the repo's actual default branch, which is still the old feature branch, not main -- confirmed live-blocking via the real GitHub API error. Workaround, not root-cause fix; see codemap history and changelog.md turn 3.

.github/workflows/ci.yml.purpose: Two parallel jobs: verify-site (scripts/verify-site.py + W3C html5validator), link-check (lychee, external links only). Previously had a third super-linter job, removed at turncount 2 (see history) after 3 rounds of real failures -- verify-site + real html5validator/stylelint runs already covered correctness. Turncount 12: lychee's args gained --exclude for the site's own domain, since turncount 12 added absolute self-referencing URLs (canonical/og:url/JSON-LD) that a live external check can't reliably resolve mid-deploy -- confirmed with the real lychee binary before applying.

.github/dependabot.yml.purpose: Weekly PRs to keep every pinned GitHub Action version/SHA current.

.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/.purpose: Two issue templates -- bug-or-content-fix.md, new-principle-suggestion.md (added turncount 12).

Re-verified with fresh screenshots (light + dark, 4 viewports) and a rendered-PDF print check rather than assuming the CSS diff alone was sufficient.

Confirmed both the v3 push (8020113: CI run 30291917438, Pages run 30291917990) and the turn-10 design-fix push (85a35c1: CI run 30292918436, Pages run 30292918359) green via the GitHub Actions API. v3 and the design QA fix are both now complete.
